messages.subject: occuFP - goodness-of-fit and cross-validation
parts: Hi all! I’m running false-positive occupancy models using occuFP in the unmarked. I want to assess the goodness-of-fit and test the predictive accuracy of the models using a leave-one-out cross-validation approach. It seems that in unmarked this cannot be done for occuFP models. Is this the case or am I missing something? Thanks in advance.
